title: Normalized scalar composition for fixed cochain models
statement: For three composable commutative ring sheaves and their ring map composition equality, fix a derived cochain scalar model for each of the three maps. There exists a unique scalar extension composition isomorphism carrying c tensor (b tensor x) to c psi(b) tensor x in every section. Models, site hypotheses and tensor generators are those of [def-weil-pbc-system-scalar-model] and [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]; independent universes are retained.

source.place: Tags 03D7 and 03EK; sites-cohomology.tex 06YY. Exact proof previously private in IntegralComparisonSequenceSystems.

proof.text: Construct normalized scalar packages whose models are exactly the supplied models. Apply the package-level normalized composition comparison and its uniqueness. Transport the result through the model equalities in the generic context. This proves the comparison for the fixed models without unfolding any particular coefficient sequence.

lean.statement:
theorem fixedScalarCompositionUnique
    {R S T : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{sw}} {φ : R ⟶ S} {ψ : S ⟶ T} {γ : R ⟶ T}
    (hγ : γ = φ ≫ ψ)
    (D1 : SheafOfModules.DerivedChangeOfRingsCochainModel φ)
    (D2 : SheafOfModules.DerivedChangeOfRingsCochainModel ψ)
    (D3 : SheafOfModules.DerivedChangeOfRingsCochainModel γ) :
    ∃! a : D1.E ⋙ D2.E ≅ D3.E,
      ∀ P U (c : T.obj.obj U) (b : S.obj.obj U) (x : P.val.obj U),
        (a.hom.app P).val.app U
          (SheafOfModules.systemModelTmul D2 (D1.E.obj P) U c
            (SheafOfModules.systemModelTmul D1 P U b x)) =
          SheafOfModules.systemModelTmul D3 P U (c * (ψ.hom.app U) b) x
